title: Explicit finite spanning family after shrinking at a minimal prime
statement: Let φ:R→S be a finite-type homomorphism of commutative rings, p a minimal prime of R, and suppose the primes of S contracting to p form a finite set. Then there are g∉p and a finite family b₁,…,bₙ in S_{φ(g)} whose R_g-span is all of S_{φ(g)}.

source.place: Tag 02ML, lemma-generically-finite; monic polynomial and monomial spanning construction

proof.text: Choose algebra generators, use finite-dimensionality of the fibre over the minimal prime to obtain monic equations, clear denominators and annihilators after shrinking, and reduce all monomials by the resulting monic equations. The resulting bounded monomials give the displayed finite spanning family, including the empty family of generators of the zero localization.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finite_span_awayMap_of_finite_fiber_minimalPrime {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (hφ : φ.FiniteType) (p : Ideal R) (hp : p ∈ minimalPrimes R) (hfinite : {q : PrimeSpectrum S | Ideal.comap φ q.asIdeal = p}.Finite) : ∃ g : R, g ∉ p ∧ letI : Algebra (Localization.Away g) (Localization.Away (φ g)) := (Localization.awayMap φ g).toAlgebra ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ b : Fin n → Localization.Away (φ g), Submodule.span (Localization.Away g) (Set.range b) = ⊤
